changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO connection_skills (id, connection_id, uri, name, title, description, starters, language, frontmatter, content, content_size, discovered_at) SELECT uuidv7(), a.id, 'app://' || a.id || '/default', 'default', a.skill ->> 'title', a.skill ->> 'description', COALESCE(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(a.skill -> 'starters')), '{}'::text[]), a.skill ->> 'language', jsonb_build_object( 'name', 'default', 'title', a.skill ->> 'title', 'description', a.skill ->> 'description', 'starters', COALESCE(a.skill -> 'starters', '[]'::jsonb), 'language', a.skill ->> 'language' ), a.skill ->> 'body', octet_length(a.skill ->> 'body'), a.updated_at FROM apps a WHERE a.skill IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM connection_skills cs WHERE cs.uri = 'app://' || a.id || '/default' );

INSERT INTO connection_skills (id, connection_id, uri, name, title, description, starters, language, frontmatter, content, content_size, discovered_at) SELECT uuidv7(), s.origin_connection_id, 'app://' || s.origin_connection_id || '/default', 'default', s.title, s.description, s.starters, NULL, jsonb_build_object( 'name', 'default', 'title', s.title, 'description', s.description, 'starters', to_jsonb(s.starters) ), s.md_content, octet_length(s.md_content), s.updated_at FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (origin_connection_id) * FROM skills WHERE origin_connection_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY origin_connection_id, (deleted_at IS NULL) DESC, updated_at DESC ) s WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM connection_skills cs WHERE cs.uri = 'app://' || s.origin_connection_id || '/default' );
UPDATE skills s SET connection_skill_id = cs.id FROM connection_skills cs WHERE s.origin_connection_id = cs.connection_id AND cs.uri = 'app://' || cs.connection_id || '/default';

changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO connection_tools (id, created_at, updated_at, connection_id, name, title, description, input_schema, output_schema, annotations) SELECT uuidv7(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, a.id, t.key, t.value ->> 'title', t.value ->> 'description', CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.value -> 'inputSchema') != 'null' THEN (t.value -> 'inputSchema')::text WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.value -> 'params') = 'array' THEN CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(t.value -> 'params') > 0 THEN jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'object', 'properties', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(p, '{}'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(t.value -> 'params') p ), '{}'::jsonb) )::text ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.value -> 'outputSchema') != 'null' THEN (t.value -> 'outputSchema')::text END, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.value -> 'annotations') != 'null' THEN (t.value -> 'annotations')::text END FROM apps a JOIN connections c ON c.id = a.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(a.tools) t WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.tools IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(a.tools) = 'object' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM connection_tools ct WHERE ct.connection_id = a.id AND ct.deleted_at IS NULL );

changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO connection_triggers (id, created_at, updated_at, connection_id, name, title, description, params_schema) SELECT uuidv7(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, a.id, t.key, t.value ->> 'title', t.value ->> 'description', CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.value -> 'paramsSchema') != 'null' THEN (t.value -> 'paramsSchema')::text WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.value -> 'params') = 'array' THEN CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(t.value -> 'params') > 0 THEN jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'object', 'properties', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(p, '{}'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(t.value -> 'params') p ), '{}'::jsonb) )::text ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END FROM apps a JOIN connections c ON c.id = a.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(a.triggers) t WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.triggers IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(a.triggers) = 'object' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM connection_triggers ct WHERE ct.connection_id = a.id AND ct.deleted_at IS NULL );
